scripts.typecheck:python: for d in packages/*/python; do if [ -d "$d" ]; then (cd "$d" && poetry run mypy .); fi; done
scripts.lint:python: for d in packages/*/python; do if [ -d "$d" ]; then (cd "$d" && poetry run ruff check .); fi; done
scripts.test:python: for d in packages/*/python; do if [ -d "$d" ]; then (cd "$d" && domain=$(basename $(dirname "$d")) && poetry run pytest --cov="soopa_${domain}" --cov-fail-under=80); fi; done
scripts.infra-reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --wait && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm db:seed
scripts.ucp-reset: (pnpm db:clear-zitadel || true) && docker compose rm -s -v -f ucp_postgres_global ucp_postgres_shard_1 localstack && docker volume rm -f soopaucp_ucp_pgdata_global soopaucp_ucp_pgdata_shard_1 && docker compose up -d --wait ucp_postgres_global ucp_postgres_shard_1 localstack && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm db:seed
scripts.deadcode:python: for d in packages/*/python; do if [ -d "$d" ]; then (cd "$d" && poetry run vulture --exclude .venv . --min-confidence 80 && poetry run deptry .); fi; done
